name: Coaster
description: Small, slow and cheap. Takes small lots of bulk and general cargo anywhere.

name: Large coaster
description: The coaster's big sister: two thirds more hold and a little quicker, still cheap to run.

name: General cargo ship
description: The workhorse. 8,000 t of bulk or general cargo, ocean range and a decent turn of speed.

name: Handysize freighter
description: Big enough for the large bulk lots, flexible enough for general cargo. Needs full holds to pay.

name: Bulk carrier
description: Huge hold for ore, coal, grain and the like. Bulk only, and it needs big lots to fill up.

name: Panamax bulker
description: The biggest ship that fits the Panama Canal. Bulk only, lives on the very largest ore, coal and grain lots.

name: Small reefer
description: A compact refrigerated ship: fruit, meat and general cargo, fast and affordable.

name: Reefer
description: Fast refrigerated ship. Carries fruit and meat, which pay well, plus general cargo.

name: Product tanker
description: Carries fuel products and chemicals, the cargo no dry ship can take. Most crude lots are too big for it.

name: Crude tanker
description: A big tanker for crude oil in volume, plus fuel products and chemicals.

name: Container feeder
description: A small, quick container ship for general cargo and refrigerated containers.

name: Container ship
description: Fast and big, built for high-value general cargo and refrigerated containers on tight deadlines.
